final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS value FROM telescope_averages), above_average AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.value AS difference FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_modindex > o.value), qualifying_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS value FROM above_average) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_modindex, a.difference, a.avg_modindex * 1.0 / NULLIF(q.value, 0) AS ratio FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS q WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
